compute_url_info: compute size and SHA-256 checksum of a local file and return a UrlInfo dataclass
create_url_info: create a UrlInfo dataclass with size, checksum, and optional filename attributes
load_url_infos: load URL-to-UrlInfo mappings from a checksums text file
save_url_infos: save URL-to-UrlInfo mappings to a checksums text file preserving existing entries
get_all_url_infos: retrieve all registered URL-to-UrlInfo mappings across all checksum directories
